about: Easy Red 2 delivers a realistic WWII shooter with historically accurate weapons, large-scale battles, and detailed historical maps. Fight on both European and Pacific fronts, including Italy, Greece, Tunisia, and Kwajalein. Experience immersive, squad-based gameplay with destructible environments and realistic vehicle mechanics where players control tanks and fight for survival.
•Fronts of War: Battle on historically accurate locations from WWII.
•Historical accuracy: Use over 70 weapons and 100 vehicles reproduced with an incredible attention to historical details.
•Squad Gameplay: Take on roles like leader, medic, or radioman; complete dynamic objectives for varied experiences.
•Vehicle Combat: Fully control tanks with crew, including survival after tank disablement.
•Multiplayer: PvP and PvE modes, with custom matches on any map.
•Map & Mission Editor: Build custom maps and missions for offline play.
•War Devastation: Destructible environments and suppression effects add realism.
This is the WWII simulation shooter for fans of tactical, large-scale combat.
summary: Easy Red 2 delivers a realistic WWII shooter with historically accurate weapons, large-scale battles, and detailed historical maps.
